# RQ1

```{r}
data_1a1b <- data_study1b |>
  select(prolific_pid, banner_yn, win_status, regret_chosen, regret_notchosen_winner, hot_set_size, outcome_rel_to_hot, choice_hot) |>
  mutate(
    study = "Study 1b"
  ) |>
  rbind(
    data_study1a |>
      select(prolific_pid, banner_yn, win_status, regret_chosen, regret_notchosen_winner, hot_set_size, outcome_rel_to_hot, choice_hot) |>
      mutate(
        study = "Study 1a"
      )
  ) |>
  filter(win_status == "Lost") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(regret_chosen, regret_notchosen_winner),
    names_to = "regret_type",
    values_to = "regret_value"
  ) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(regret_pmc = regret_value - mean(regret_value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    regret_type = recode(
      regret_type,
      regret_chosen = "Commission",
      regret_notchosen_winner = "Omission"
    ),
    hot_set_group = case_when(
      banner_yn == "No Banner" ~ "CF-",
      banner_yn == "Banner" ~ "CF+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) 
```

```{r}
data_1a1b_fig2 <- data_1a1b |>
  filter(outcome_rel_to_hot == "hot_win_number" | is.na(outcome_rel_to_hot)) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid, hot_set_group, regret_type) |>
  mutate(mean_regret = mean(regret_pmc, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(prolific_pid, hot_set_group, regret_type, mean_regret, study) |>
  distinct()
                  
```

```{r}
plot_fig2 <- data_1a1b_fig2 |>
  mutate(
    study = factor(study, levels = c("Study 1a", "Study 1b")),
    hot_set_group = factor(hot_set_group, levels = c("CF-", "CF+")),
    regret_type = recode(
      regret_type,
      "Commission regret" = "Commission",
      "Omission regret"   = "Omission"
    ),
    regret_type = factor(regret_type, levels = c("Commission", "Omission"))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(hot_set_group), !is.na(regret_type), !is.na(mean_regret))

pal_regret_type <- c(
  "Commission" = "#8B1E3F",
  "Omission"   = "#1F4E79"
)

fig_w <- 8.27
fig_h <- 5.83

fig2 <- ggplot(
  plot_fig2,
  aes(x = hot_set_group, y = mean_regret, color = regret_type)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#60676A", linewidth = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_boot, conf.int = .95, B = 5000,
    geom = "pointrange", linewidth = 1.0, size = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.35)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "A",
    x = "Trial type",
    y = "Regret (person-centered)",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_regret_type) +
  facet_wrap(~ study) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2), nrow = 1)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),

    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
    
    # increase title font
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),

    strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),

    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

print(fig2)

# 4) Export (vector PDF, consistent fonts)
ggsave(
  filename = "../../figures/fig2.pdf",
  plot = fig2,
  device = pdf,
  width = fig_w,
  height = fig_h
)
```
## 1a

```{r}
data_q1_1a <- data_study1a |>
  filter(win_status == "Lost") |>
  filter(outcome_rel_to_hot == "hot_win_number" | is.na(outcome_rel_to_hot)) |>
  select(prolific_pid, banner_yn, regret_chosen, regret_notchosen_winner, outcome_rel_to_hot) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(regret_chosen, regret_notchosen_winner),
    names_to = "regret_type",
    values_to = "regret_value"
  ) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(regret_pmc = regret_value - mean(regret_value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() 

tab_model(lmer(regret_pmc ~ banner_yn * regret_type + (1 | prolific_pid), data = data_q1_1a))

model_q1_1a <- brm(regret_pmc ~ banner_yn * regret_type + (1 | prolific_pid),
  data = data_q1_1a,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1000,
  seed = 1234
)

summary(model_q1_1a)
pp_check(model_q1_1a)
tab_model(model_q1_1a)
```

#RQ3

```{r}
data_q3 <- data_study2 |>
  filter(win_status == "Lost") |>
  filter(outcome_rel_to_consider == "winner_in_set" | is.na(outcome_rel_to_consider)) |>
  select(prolific_pid, regret_chosen, regret_notchosen_winner, consider_set_size) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(regret_chosen, regret_notchosen_winner),
    names_to = "regret_type",
    values_to = "regret_value"
  ) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(regret_pmc = regret_value - mean(regret_value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(prolific_pid, consider_set_size, regret_type) |>
  mutate(mean_regret = mean(regret_pmc, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(prolific_pid, consider_set_size, regret_type, mean_regret) |>
  mutate(consider_set_size = as.numeric(consider_set_size)) |>
  mutate(consider_set_size = factor(consider_set_size, levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 8, 16))) |>
  distinct()
```

```{r}
plot_fig4 <- data_q3 |>
  mutate(
    regret_type = recode(
      regret_type,
      "regret_chosen" = "Commission",
      "regret_notchosen_winner"   = "Omission"
    ),
    regret_type = factor(regret_type, levels = c("Commission", "Omission"))
  ) |>
  mutate(study = "Study 2")
  
pal_regret_type <- c(
  "Commission" = "#8B1E3F",
  "Omission"   = "#1F4E79"
)

fig_w <- 8.27
fig_h <- 5.83

fig4 <- ggplot(
  plot_fig4,
  aes(x = consider_set_size, y = mean_regret, color = regret_type)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#60676A", linewidth = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_boot, conf.int = .95, B = 5000,
    geom = "pointrange", linewidth = 1.0, size = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.35)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Consideration set size",
    y = "Regret (person-centered)",
    color = NULL,
    title = "C"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_regret_type) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 8, 16)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2), nrow = 1)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),

    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 22),

    strip.text = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", hjust = 0),

    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines")
  ) +
```

```{r}
data_q3_1 <- data_study2 |>
  filter(win_status == "Lost") |>
  filter(outcome_rel_to_consider == "winner_in_set" | is.na(outcome_rel_to_consider)) |>
  select(prolific_pid, regret_chosen, regret_notchosen_winner, is_no_consider_trial) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(regret_chosen, regret_notchosen_winner),
    names_to = "regret_type",
    values_to = "regret_value"
  ) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(regret_pmc = regret_value - mean(regret_value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(prolific_pid, is_no_consider_trial, regret_type) |>
  mutate(mean_regret = mean(regret_pmc, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() 

tab_model(lmer(mean_regret ~ is_no_consider_trial * regret_type + (1 | prolific_pid), data = data_q3_1))
```

# Exploratory analyses

```{r}
plot_dat_fig2 <- data_study1b |>
  filter(
    win_status == "Lost",
    hot_set_size %in% c(1, 2, 3, 8, 16),
    outcome_rel_to_hot %in% c("hot_win_number", "nonhot_win_number")
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(regret_chosen, regret_notchosen_winner),
    names_to = "regret_type",
    values_to = "regret_value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    regret_type = recode(
      regret_type,
      regret_chosen = "Commission",
      regret_notchosen_winner = "Omission"
    ),
    outcome_rel_to_hot = recode(
      outcome_rel_to_hot,
      hot_win_number = "Winner in hot set",
      nonhot_win_number = "Winner outside hot set"
    ),
    choice_hot = case_when(
      choice_hot %in% c("Chose Hot", "Hot", "TRUE", "True", TRUE, 1, "1") ~ "Chose Hot",
      choice_hot %in% c("Chose Non-Hot", "Non-Hot", "FALSE", "False", FALSE, 0, "0") ~ "Chose Non-Hot",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(choice_hot)) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(regret_pmc = regret_value - mean(regret_value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    legend_label = paste(regret_type, outcome_rel_to_hot, sep = " — "),
    legend_label = factor(
      legend_label,
      levels = c(
        "Commission — Winner in hot set",
        "Commission — Winner outside hot set",
        "Omission — Winner in hot set",
        "Omission — Winner outside hot set"
      )
    ),
    outcome_rel_to_hot = factor(
      outcome_rel_to_hot,
      levels = c("Winner in hot set", "Winner outside hot set")
    ),
    hot_set_size = factor(hot_set_size, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 8, 16)),
    choice_hot   = factor(choice_hot, levels = c("Chose Hot", "Chose Non-Hot"))
  )

pal_fig2 <- c(
  "Commission — Winner in hot set"         = "#8B1E3F",
  "Commission — Winner outside hot set"    = "#D8A2AE",
  "Omission — Winner in hot set"           = "#1F4E79",
  "Omission — Winner outside hot set"      = "#A9C0D8"
)

p_fig2 <- ggplot(
  plot_dat_fig2,
  aes(
    x = outcome_rel_to_hot,
    y = regret_pmc,
    color = legend_label,
    fill  = legend_label
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_boot,
    conf.int = .95,
    B = 5000,
    geom = "pointrange",
    linewidth = 1,
    size = 1,
    shape = 21,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.35)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_fig2, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_fig2, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Study 1b",
    x = "Hot set size",
    y = "Regret (person-centered)",
    color = "Regret type",
    fill  = "Regret type"
  ) +
  facet_grid(choice_hot ~ hot_set_size, switch = "both") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),

    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),

    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),

    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines")
  ) +
guides(
  color = guide_legend(
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE,
    override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2)
  ),
  fill = guide_legend(
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE,
    override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2)
  )
)

print(p_fig2)

ggsave(
  filename = "../../figures/fig2_study1b_choicehot_by_hotsetsize.pdf",
  plot = p_fig2,
  device = pdf,
  width = 12,   
  height = 6,
  bg = "white"
)
```
